verification_policy: Every value must map to an official source link. Unconfirmed values are left blank and flagged UNVERIFIED on the Flagged for Review page.

sources.title: Trip Lever Installation Instructions (Model 500/550/600/650 bath wastes)
sources.supports: Official anatomy of a trip-lever bath waste: overflow plate, linkage, drop-cylinder (plunger), overflow elbow, drain elbow, tee; assembly is fastened under/behind the tub.

sources.title: Product index (trip lever bath wastes)
sources.supports: Trip lever product family names (500-TL, 550-TL, 600-TL, 650-TL, slip-lock and quick-adjust variants).

sources.title: Tub and Shower Drains — trip lever identification
sources.supports: Trip lever drain definition (lever on overflow plate opens/closes the drain); Moen replacement units 90410 (14-16 in. tubs) and 90480 (16-24 in. tubs); tubing not sold separately.

sources.title: How to Remove and Replace a Bathtub
sources.supports: Waste-and-overflow assembly sits under/behind the tub: drain shoe on the underside of the tub, overflow elbow and gasket behind the tub wall, tee joining overflow pipe and drain pipe.

sources.title: How to Replace a Bathtub Drain Stopper With a Lift-and-Turn Drain
sources.supports: Lever-style (trip lever) drains use a complicated internal linkage that catches hair; common professional conversion is to a simpler lift-and-turn stopper with blank overflow plate.

sources.title: How to Remove a Trip-Lever Drain Stopper
sources.supports: Standard removal from above (clip, cover plate, pull plunger); documented risk: plunger rod can break off and stay stuck in the piping; lubricant + straight pull, do not force at an angle.

sources.title: How to Remove a Bathtub Drain by Type
sources.supports: Trip lever removal steps from above; if the assembly is stuck, lubricant first; forcing it can break the assembly and may require professional help to fix.

sources.title: How Much Does Plumbing Repair Cost? [2026 Data]
sources.supports: 2026 national averages: plumbing repair $341 avg ($182-$501 typical, up to $993); service call $100-$250; hourly $45-$200; flat rates $100-$400; fixture replacement $150-$600; cutting drywall to reach pipes raises cost and plumbers may bring in a separate contractor for structural repairs.

sources.title: Bathtub Overflow Drains: Gasket Leaks and Waste Kits
sources.supports: Replacing the full waste-and-overflow usually requires access from behind or below the tub; drywall and ceiling repair below is a separate cost that can rival the plumbing bill; hidden water damage adds substantially.

sources.title: Bathtub Drain Drama: Why You Need a Licensed and Insured Plumber Fast
sources.supports: Complete waste-and-overflow replacement priced $300-$600; with clear access via panel or ceiling below the job takes 2-4 hours; cracked/leaking waste-and-overflow pipes require full assembly replacement.
